# XLaya (iscvlab/xlaya)

> 3-Stage System 1 → System 1.5 Semantic Decision, Joint NLI Contradiction Triad, Thorough Scan & Conformal Triage Sidecar (`v2.1.0`), powered by `laya 0.4.31+` (`ModernBERT-large` `en`, `subfolder="typed-decisions"`, calibrated `0.45*en + 0.55*typed` ensemble & `mmBERT`) and `vega-U` (`vegaml 0.16.1+`, `auto`/`0.8b`/`4b`/`gemma-1b`/`27b`), delivered as a warm resident Model Context Protocol server (`xlaya_mcp_server.py`, `6` tools, `~30 ms` warm inference, `859.1 q/s` batched), a standalone CLI (`laya_triage.py`), and a universal AI agent skill (`skills/xlaya/SKILL.md`).

## One-Prompt Universal Agent Install

```text
Clone https://github.com/iscvlab/xlaya and install skills/xlaya into my active agent skills directory (Windows: ./scripts/install.ps1 -All; macOS/Linux: ./scripts/install.sh --all; or copy skills/xlaya into ~/.gemini/config/skills/xlaya, ~/.claude/skills/xlaya, ~/.codex/skills/xlaya, or ~/.agents/skills/xlaya), then run python benchmarks/run_xlaya_benchmark.py --mode quick to verify /xlaya is ready.
```

## Core Entrypoints & Documentation

- [README.md](README.md): Architecture, 5 pure-local high-accuracy upgrades (`v2.1.0`), 4-axis RTX 5060 Ti benchmarks, one-prompt agent installer, 6 MCP tools, and CLI usage.
- [laya_triage.py](laya_triage.py): Standalone 3-stage CLI & programmatic engine (`--mode shortlist|contradiction|rubric|classify`, `--lang auto|en|multi|typed|ensemble`, `--thorough`, `--rubric-preset`, `--views 1|2|3`, `--fit-rows`, `--policy-path`, `--image|--audio|--video`, `--vega`, `--vega-model auto|0.8b|4b|gemma-1b|27b`, `--whole-file`, `--self-test`).
- [xlaya_mcp_server.py](xlaya_mcp_server.py): Zero-extra-dependency JSON-RPC 2.0 `stdio` MCP server (`xlaya_status`, `xlaya_triage`, `xlaya_predict`, `xlaya_fit`, `xlaya_preload`, `xlaya_unload`) with idle VRAM auto-unload (`LAYA_IDLE_TTL_SEC`).
- [skills/xlaya/SKILL.md](skills/xlaya/SKILL.md): Portable AI agent skill specification (`/xlaya`, `/laya`) and chained `/x*` combinations (`/xsync /xlaya`, `/xbrief /xlaya`, `/xdeep-research /xlaya`, `/xpublish /xlaya`, `/xlaya /xultra`, `/xlearn /xlaya`, `/xocr /xlaya`).
- [scripts/install.ps1](scripts/install.ps1): Windows PowerShell installer (`./scripts/install.ps1 -All` or `-Target <dir>`).
- [scripts/install.sh](scripts/install.sh): macOS and Linux installer (`./scripts/install.sh --all` or `--target <dir>`).
- [benchmarks/XLAYA_V2_BENCHMARK_REPORT.md](benchmarks/XLAYA_V2_BENCHMARK_REPORT.md): Comprehensive 4-axis empirical benchmark report on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Ti (`16 GB VRAM`).
- [benchmarks/xlaya_v2_benchmark_results.json](benchmarks/xlaya_v2_benchmark_results.json): Verified raw JSON benchmark receipts across latency, batch determinism (`0 / 432` flips), conformal `vega-U` calibration (`90.0%` 40-row accuracy), Joint NLI Contradiction Triad (`8 / 8`), and XERJ `#1108` Watcher Gate (`0.00%` false-confident).
- [benchmarks/run_xlaya_benchmark.py](benchmarks/run_xlaya_benchmark.py): Reproducible Stage 0 + Stage 1 + Stage 2 verification harness (`--mode quick|full`).
